popupProfileFullOnly: Full only: Lite cannot capture what this profile records.
popupProfileRequired: Recording needs at least one profile. Restore the recommended profiles or import yours in Options.
popupProfileCancelRuleChanged: It recorded with {started}, but the site rules pick {next} for this page.
popupProfileCancelRuleChangedFix: To keep recording here with {started}, choose it in the profile list instead of Auto, or add a site rule for this site in Options → Profiles.
popupProfileCancelMissing: The profile {started} was deleted while recording.
popupProfileCancelMissingFix: Choose another profile, or create or restore one in Options → Profiles, then start again.
popupProfileCancelEdited: The profile {started} was changed while recording.
popupProfileCancelEditedFix: Start a new recording to record with the new settings.
popupProfileCancelPolicy: Your organization's policy changed what {started} may record.
popupProfileCancelPolicyFix: Start a new recording. Ask your administrator if you need more data.
popupProfileCancelKept: What was recorded before the change is kept: export or delete it.
popupExportPassphraseBody: Archives are always encrypted (AES-GCM). Enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters: you need it to open the archive.
popupPassphraseRequired: Enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters: archives are always encrypted.
popupExportTimedOut: Export did not finish within 2 minutes. Check Chrome downloads or reload the extension and retry.
popupExportPrivacyWarningAlert: Export completed, but the privacy scanner found {count} possible sensitive item(s): {summary}. Review the archive before sharing.
popupReloadTitle: Reload the Page When Recording Starts?
popupReloadBody: Recording starts first, then the page reloads, so the session captures its load from scratch: the first network requests, scripts, and early console messages and errors. Unsaved changes on the page may be lost. You can turn this question off in Settings.
optionsScreenshotIdleHelp: Lite screenshots are off by default. Set a positive interval only when screenshots are allowed. Full mode uses it for browser-side screenshot cadence.
optionsBodyCaptureHelp: Lite never captures page-side response bodies. This caps the browser-side body capture used by Full mode; profiles can override it.
optionsFreezeHelp: Performance-triggered freezes stay off in the shipped runtime; only errors and markers freeze.
optionsProfilesHint: Profiles decide what is recorded. Presets are read-only: duplicate one to edit it. Any profile can be deleted except the ones from your organization's policy; recording needs at least one.
optionsProfilesManagedNotice: Profiles named managed:* come from your organization's policy.
optionsProfileDeleteRules: {count} site rule(s) use this profile. They are kept but skipped until they get a profile again:
optionsProfileIncludeUrls: Capture bodies only for these URL globs
optionsProfileExcludeUrls: Never capture bodies for these URL globs
optionsRedactionDisclaimer: Masking applies your rules on a best-effort basis; WebBlackbox does not guarantee that all sensitive data is removed. Archives are always encrypted.
optionsProfileBuiltInHeuristics: Built-in heuristics (secret detection, URL stripping, raw DOM sanitizing)
optionsProfileValuePatterns: Value patterns, one per line: [bodies, dom, storage, inputs, console, urls] regex (no prefix: everywhere)
optionsRulesHint: Rules only pick a profile for a page; recording always starts manually. If the profile changes while recording, the recording stops.
optionsRuleProfileMissingHint: This rule points at a deleted profile and is skipped. Pick another profile or restore the recommended profiles.
optionsProfilesEmpty: No profiles left: recording is disabled until you restore the recommended profiles or import profiles.
optionsProfileDeleteNoRules: No site rule uses this profile.
optionsProfileDeleteRestorable: You can bring it back later with “Restore recommended profiles”.
optionsProfileDeleteOwn: This is your own profile: once you save, it cannot be restored.
optionsProfileDeleteLast: Recording needs at least one profile. Duplicate a profile or restore the recommended ones before deleting this one.
optionsProfilesRestoreHint: Brings back Default and the built-in presets you deleted. Your own profiles and site rules stay as they are.
optionsProfilesRestoreNothing: All recommended profiles are in the list.
optionsRuleProfileMissingHintOwn: This rule points at a deleted profile and is skipped. Pick another profile for it.
optionsRulesOrphaned: {count} site rule(s) point at deleted profiles and are skipped.
optionsProfilesImportNoChanges: The file matches the current profiles.
optionsSandboxHint: Paste a sample to see what the selected profile hides.
optionsSandboxInvalidJson: Event payload must be valid JSON.
optionsAutoFreezeOnBreach: Freeze when a budget is broken
sessionsSubtitle: Recordings kept on this computer. Export one to share it or open it in the Player.
sessionsDeletePrompt: Delete session {sid}? This removes local archive data.
sessionsExportDialogBody: Archives are always encrypted (AES-GCM). Enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters: you need it to open the archive.
popupDisconnected: Lost the connection to the extension. Close and reopen the popup.
optionsArchiveSaveFailed: The browser refused to store the archive settings.
optionsLeaveBody: Save them before you switch sections, or discard them. Discard drops every unsaved change: {sections}.
optionsLeaveBlockedBody: Some fields are invalid, so nothing can be saved yet. Stay to fix them, or discard every unsaved change: {sections}.
optionsProfileCloseBody: Apply only closes the form; nothing is stored until you save. Save changes stores every unsaved setting, Discard changes puts this profile back as it was when you opened it.
optionsProfileDiscardBody: The profile goes back to how it was when you opened it.
optionsRuleCloseBody: This rule does not apply until it is saved. Save changes stores every unsaved setting, Discard changes puts the rule back as it was saved.
optionsRuleCloseBodyNew: This new rule does not apply until it is saved. Save changes stores every unsaved setting, Discard changes removes the rule.
optionsSensitivityHint: What is masked before data leaves the page. Applies to the Default profile.
optionsPointerHint: How often pointer and scroll movement is sampled.
optionsSamplingHint: Buffer length and capture cadence; lower values cost less CPU.
optionsBudgetsHint: Warn when a page breaks these performance limits.
optionsTransferHint: Share profiles and rules with your team as one JSON file.
optionsBlockedSelectorsHint: Elements whose content is never recorded.
optionsBlockedSelectorsHelp: CSS selectors matched against the page. Matching elements are masked in DOM snapshots, screenshots and input values. Each entry is checked with querySelector.
optionsBodySensitivePatternsHint: Values after these keys are masked in bodies.
optionsBodySensitivePatternsHelp: Matched in JSON, form-encoded and query-like bodies; the value after a matching key is replaced, the key stays readable.
optionsHashSensitiveValuesHint: Keeps equal values comparable without storing them.
optionsErrorTitleRegex: Not a usable title pattern (check the syntax; backreferences and lookarounds are not allowed).
optionsErrorMime: Use type/subtype, e.g. text/* or application/json.
optionsActionWindowHint: Requests this soon after a click belong to it.
optionsActionWindowHelp: Network requests that start within this window after a user action are linked to it, so the Player can show what a click caused.
optionsRingBufferHint: How much recent history is kept.
optionsRingBufferHelp: Older events are dropped as new ones arrive, unless a freeze (error, marker) preserves the buffer.
optionsDomFlushHint: How often DOM changes are batched.
optionsSnapshotIntervalHint: Full snapshots for seeking in the Player.
optionsBodyCaptureHint: Largest response body kept in Full mode.
optionsFreezeOnErrorHint: Keeps the buffer around an error.
optionsStartReloadOffer: Offer to reload the page when recording starts
optionsStartReloadOfferHint: Start asks whether to reload the page first, to record its load. When off, recording starts without a reload.
optionsLcpWarnHint: Largest Contentful Paint slower than this.
optionsRequestWarnHint: Requests slower than this count as slow.
optionsAutoFreezeHint: Keeps the buffer around the breach.
optionsRecentWindowHint: How much recent history an export keeps.
optionsRecentWindowHelp: Events older than this window before the export are left out of the archive.
optionsEncryptionNote: Every archive is encrypted (AES-GCM) with a passphrase of at least 8 characters, asked for at export. Privacy scanner findings are shown after an export and never block it.
optionsLanguagePendingReload: Language saved. Save or discard your changes, then reopen this page to see it.
optionsLanguageFollowsBrowser: Auto follows Chrome's language. The popup and Sessions page switch the next time they open.
optionsProfileCategoriesHint: Left = least data, right = most. Click a level to change it.
optionsProfileBaseHelp: Lite records from the page; Full adds the browser's DevTools protocol (network bodies, screenshots). The popup preselects this engine.
optionsProfileEditorEmpty: Choose Edit on a profile, or duplicate a preset to customise it.
optionsProfileUnmaskHint: Stay readable even when blocked; password fields never are.
optionsProfileBodyMimeHint: Empty uses the transport default list.
optionsRulesEmpty: No rules yet: every page uses the default profile.
optionsTestIdle: Enter a URL to see which profile Start would use.
optionsTestByRule: Chosen by rule “{rule}” (priority {priority}) because it matched:
optionsTestNoRule: No rule matches, so the default profile is used.
optionsTestUnchecked: Not checked here (need the page's selector or meta tag): {rules}.
optionsProfilesExportHint: Download profiles and rules as JSON.
optionsProfilesImportHint: You see a diff before anything changes.
sessionsSearchPlaceholder: Search site, tag, note or id
sessionsBulkDeletePrompt: Delete {count} session(s)? This removes their local archive data.
sessionsBulkDeleteLivePrompt: Delete {count} session(s)? {live} of them are still recording and will be stopped first. This removes their local archive data.
sessionsDeleteLivePrompt: Session {sid} is still recording. Stop it and delete its local archive data?
sessionsOpenPlayerHint: Exports the archive to your downloads, then opens the Player. Drop the downloaded .webblackbox file into it; nothing is uploaded.
